core.title: Wire Style Solid Cast Bronze Appliance Pull, Hamilton AP-112
tags: Wire Style Solid Cast Bronze Appliance Pulls

text.description_html:
Wire Style Solid Cast Bronze Appliance Pull

Traditional Style pull for your refrigerator or other appliances, cast in solid bronze with high quality craftsmanship. Available in lengths of 15", 18", 24", and 30". It features circular mounts.

The Hamilton AP-112 pulls are packaged standard for Thrubolt Mounting for a Refrigerator/Appliance panel.

Large "vacuum" sealed doors such as the those found on Sub Zero refrigerators are recommended to have 18" or longer pulls installed to effectively pull open it.

Available in 4 lengths:

  • AP-112-15-BP: Center to Center Hole Spacing: 15"
  • AP-112-18-BP: Center to Center Hole Spacing: 18"
  • AP-112-24-BP: Center to Center Hole Spacing: 24"
  • AP-112-30-BP: Center to Center Hole Spacing: 30"

Specifications of the bronze appliance pulls:

  • Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Pull Diameter: 5/8"
  • Bronze Patina finish over Solid Cast Bronze
  • Hamilton AP-112 Specifications (PDF)
